title: Actseal release build receipt (schema 1, promotion profile)
description: build-receipt.json written by `tools/check_release.py distributions` in the release workflow's build job, before the immutable distributions artifact exists. The promotion profile described here requires a release tag, a full source commit and the originating workflow run; a rehearsal build (branch ref, null tag, null workflow metadata) is inspection-only and never validates. `lock_sha256` is the SHA-256 of the repository `uv.lock` at the source commit, not an Actseal decision lock. Unknown fields are rejected everywhere. The helper is stricter: exact integer schema version, lowercase hashes, exactly one wheel and one sdist whose names, sizes and hashes equal the built files.

Decimal.description: A positive ASCII decimal identifier without leading zeros, as GitHub reports run and artifact IDs.

Distributions.description: Exactly the wheel and the sdist of the receipt's version, sorted by filename. Name/version agreement and uniqueness are cross-field checks enforced by the helper.
